<TEI xmlns='http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0'><seg xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" type="excerpt" xml:id="ex040012026-09-0404-58-24" status="unreviewed"><lb edRef="inst:4749" n="132a8"/> skal laM kyi rgyu ni byas pas ji lta bu zhe na zhes pa
            lasogs pa ste || gi dang du rgyas pa dir rigs 'dra ba rgyug mi 'chad par 'byung ba'o ||
            mchog du byas pa ni gong nas gsu 'phel ba'o zhes <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3921">tho</rs> zer ro || 
            yang na rgyas pa ni cung zad 'phel ba'o zhes <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3864">skyab</rs> gsung ngo || </seg></TEI>
